description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Contract"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Project" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Query" name="Query" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Query"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrder" name="Initial parts order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapReorder" name="Cheapest reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapBatch" name="Reordered parts batch" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_CheapBatch" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastReorder" name="Fastest reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastBatch" name="Reordered parts batch" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_FastBatch" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint email" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Query" name="Shop query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Offers: quantity, price and delivery time"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Delivery" name="Parts batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint about web shops"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Contract">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ProjectOwner" name="Project owner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Contract</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreatePartsList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_QueryShops</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompareOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OneShopEnough</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ListOneShop</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ListSeveralShops</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeOrderLists</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceInitialOrders</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FirstBatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartBuilding</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Build</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StockZero</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EmailFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeZeroCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BelowFive</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReorderCheapest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CheapBatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateAfterCheapBatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BelowThree</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReorderFastest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FastBatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateAfterFastBatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_BuildingUnderway</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Contract project starts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePartsList" name="Create list of required parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops" messageRef="Message_Query"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers from all web shops" messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompareOffers" name="Compare available quantities, prices and delivery times; select cheapest parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OneShopEnough" name="Can one shop supply the required quantities?" default="Flow_NotEnoughFromOne"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ListOneShop" name="Create order list for one shop"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ListSeveralShops" name="Create order lists across shops using the cheapest parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeOrderLists" name="Merge order-list paths"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" name="Place initial orders" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FirstBatch" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Build" name="Build using available parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockZero" name="Is stock for a part zero?" default="Flow_StockNotZero"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Write an email to friends complaining about the web shops" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeZeroCheck" name="Continue stock check"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BelowFive" name="Is stock for a part below 5?" default="Flow_NotBelowFive"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the cheapest parts" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CheapBatch" name="Cheapest reorder batch arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CheapBatch" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateAfterCheapBatch" name="Update stock for received batch"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BelowThree" name="Is stock for a part below 3?" default="Flow_NotBelowThree"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder the fastest parts" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FastBatch" name="Fastest reorder batch arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FastBatch" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateAfterFastBatch" name="Update stock for received batch"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BuildingUnderway" name="Building is underway"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_CreatePartsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CreatePartsList" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_CompareOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_CompareOffers" targetRef="Gateway_OneShopEnough"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShopEnough" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OneShopEnough" targetRef="Task_ListOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${oneShopCanSupplyRequiredQuantities}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotEnoughFromOne" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OneShopEnough" targetRef="Task_ListSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ListOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_MergeOrderLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_ListSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_MergeOrderLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeOrderLists" targetRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInitialOrders" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Event_FirstBatch" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_Build" targetRef="Gateway_StockZero"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockZero" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockZero" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockForPartIsZero}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockNotZero" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockZero" targetRef="Gateway_MergeZeroCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Gateway_MergeZeroCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeZeroCheck" targetRef="Gateway_BelowFive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowFive" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowFive" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockForPartBelow5}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotBelowFive" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowFive" targetRef="End_BuildingUnderway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Event_CheapBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Event_CheapBatch" targetRef="Task_UpdateAfterCheapBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_UpdateAfterCheapBatch" targetRef="Gateway_BelowThree"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThree" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowThree" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockForPartBelow3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotBelowThree" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowThree" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Event_FastBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Event_FastBatch" targetRef="Task_UpdateAfterFastBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_UpdateAfterFastBatch" targetRef="Task_Build"/>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_DeliveryTiming">
      <bpmn:text>Parts arrive in batches in random order; delivery is typically 2 days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_DeliveryTiming" sourceRef="Annotation_DeliveryTiming" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
